ARABIC LANGUAGE — MOCK EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does the Arabic sentence أَنَا مِنْ كينيا mean? (1 mark)
   A. I am from Kenya.
   B. I am a pupil (boy).
   C. I am a pupil (girl).
   D. My name is Ahmad.

2. Which is the best answer to kayfa haaluka? (1 mark)
   A. ismii Ahmad
   B. anaa bi-khayr, al-hamdu lillaah
   C. hal ʿindaka hafla?
   D. maʿa s-salaama

3. Which Arabic word means "good morning"? (1 mark)
   A. مَعَ السَّلَامَةِ
   B. وَعَلَيْكُمُ السَّلَامُ
   C. شُكْرًا
   D. صَبَاحُ الْخَيْرِ

4. How is the Arabic word أُسْرَةٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. usra
   B. bint
   C. ukht
   D. khaal

5. What does the Arabic word أَبٌ (ab) mean? (1 mark)
   A. mother's brother
   B. father's brother
   C. sister
   D. father

6. What does the Arabic word خَالَةٌ (khaala) mean? (1 mark)
   A. mother
   B. mother's brother
   C. son
   D. mother's sister

7. Which word do you add to an instruction to make it polite? (1 mark)
   A. yawm
   B. min fadlika
   C. ayna
   D. al-yawm

8. What does the Arabic word الْيَوْمَ (al-yawm) mean? (1 mark)
   A. today
   B. Sunday
   C. day
   D. Monday

9. What does the word wa mean in khubzan wa bayDan? (1 mark)
   A. or
   B. and
   C. in
   D. with

10. What does the Arabic word مَاءٌ (maa') mean? (1 mark)
   A. maize
   B. chicken
   C. water
   D. sugar

11. What does the Arabic word لَحْمٌ (lahm) mean? (1 mark)
   A. bread
   B. carrots
   C. meat
   D. eggs

12. Which Arabic word means "write"? (1 mark)
   A. اُكْتُبْ
   B. أَغْمِضْ عَيْنَيْكَ
   C. افْتَحِ الْبَابَ
   D. اِلْمَسْ أَنْفَكَ

13. Which Arabic word means "touch your nose"? (1 mark)
   A. اِلْمَسْ أَنْفَكَ
   B. أَغْمِضْ عَيْنَيْكَ
   C. اُخْرُجْ
   D. اِقْرَأْ

14. What does the Arabic sentence الْجَوُّ مُمْطِرٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. The weather is hot.
   B. The weather is rainy.
   C. The weather is cold.
   D. The weather is cloudy.

15. Which Arabic sentence means "The weather is cloudy." (1 mark)
   A. الْجَوُّ حَارٌّ
   B. الْجَوُّ مُمْطِرٌ
   C. الْجَوُّ بَارِدٌ
   D. الْجَوُّ غَائِمٌ

16. What does the Arabic sentence الْجَوُّ غَائِمٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. The weather is rainy.
   B. The weather is cold.
   C. The weather is cloudy.
   D. The weather is hot.

17. What is the name of the Arabic letter ت? (1 mark)
   A. taa
   B. Saad
   C. daal
   D. Haa

18. Which mark gives the short vowel 'i'? (1 mark)
   A. shadda
   B. Damma, a curl above the letter
   C. kasra, a small line below the letter
   D. fatHa, a line above the letter

19. In which direction is Arabic read? (1 mark)
   A. From right to left
   B. From left to right
   C. From the middle
   D. From top to bottom only

20. What does the Arabic sentence أُخْتِي جَمِيلَةٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. My brother is small.
   B. Hello, Ahmad.
   C. My sister is beautiful.
   D. My grandfather is old (big in age).

21. Which day is al-khamiis? (1 mark)
   A. Saturday
   B. Tuesday
   C. Friday
   D. Thursday

22. Which Arabic word means "Sunday"? (1 mark)
   A. أَمْسِ
   B. أُسْبُوعٌ
   C. الثُّلَاثَاءُ
   D. الْأَحَدُ

23. Which Arabic word means "please, go ahead"? (1 mark)
   A. عِيدُ مِيلَادٍ
   B. تَفَضَّلْ
   C. لَا
   D. شَمْعَةٌ

24. What does the Arabic question mark ؟ tell the reader? (1 mark)
   A. Stop reading
   B. The voice falls
   C. Read very fast
   D. The voice rises at the end

25. How is the Arabic word مِلْعَقَةٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. baab
   B. hadiiqa
   C. milʿaqa
   D. qalam

26. What is a class portfolio? (1 mark)
   A. A test paper
   B. A single picture
   C. A kind of desk
   D. A folder of the class's best work

27. What does the Arabic sentence نَحْنُ نَرْقُصُ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I have a gift.
   B. I like the party.
   C. My mother cooks the food.
   D. We dance.

28. Which Arabic word means "salt"? (1 mark)
   A. بَطَاطِسُ
   B. مِلْحٌ
   C. تُفَّاحٌ
   D. مَاءٌ

29. Which Arabic word means "rice"? (1 mark)
   A. أَرُزٌّ
   B. لَحْمٌ
   C. سُكَّرٌ
   D. شَايٌ

30. What does the Arabic sentence الرِّيحُ قَوِيَّةٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. The wind is strong.
   B. The sun is hot.
   C. This is the sun.
   D. This is rain.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Translate into English: kayfa l-jawwu l-yawm? (2 marks)

32. Describe how to make a food chart for the class wall. (3 marks) (3 marks)

33. Blend the syllables and give the meaning: jad + da + tun. (2 marks) (2 marks)

34. Translate into English: nuhaafidhu ʿalaa l-bii'a (2 marks)

35. Describe a game you can play with a partner to practise the position words. (3 marks) (3 marks)

36. Translate into English: anaa tilmiidha (2 marks)

37. Translate into English: man haadhaa? (2 marks)

38. Translate into English: al-jawwu mumtir (2 marks)

39. Give three examples of non-verbal cues you could use when reciting a poem about weather. (3 marks) (3 marks)

40. Write five words about a celebration in Arabic (English letters are fine) with their meanings. (5 marks) (5 marks)

41. Name two common foods in your area and write one Arabic sentence about one of them, with its meaning. (3 marks) (3 marks)

42. Give three things you can do to listen attentively. (3 marks) (3 marks)

43. Give two ways of keeping household items safe. (2 marks) (2 marks)

44. Describe how to draw and label a household item. (4 marks) (4 marks)

45. Name three Arabic writing styles and state one use of one of them. (3 marks) (3 marks)

46. Translate into English: ummii tatbukhu (2 marks)

47. Write five words about weather and the environment in Arabic (English letters are fine) with their meanings. (5 marks) (5 marks)

48. Translate into English: abii yaʿmalu (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ARABIC LANGUAGE — MOCK EXAM #18 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — I am from Kenya.
   أَنَا مِنْ كينيا (anaa min Kiiniya) means: I am from Kenya.

2. B — anaa bi-khayr, al-hamdu lillaah
   The question asks how you are, so the answer says 'I am well, thanks be to God'.

3. D — صَبَاحُ الْخَيْرِ
   صَبَاحُ الْخَيْرِ (sabaahu l-khayr) means good morning.

4. A — usra
   أُسْرَةٌ is read usra and means family.

5. D — father
   أَبٌ (ab) means father.

6. D — mother's sister
   خَالَةٌ (khaala) means mother's sister.

7. B — min fadlika
   min fadlika means 'please'.

8. A — today
   الْيَوْمَ (al-yawm) means today.

9. B — and
   wa means 'and', so the phrase is 'bread and eggs'.

10. C — water
   مَاءٌ (maa') means water.

11. C — meat
   لَحْمٌ (lahm) means meat.

12. A — اُكْتُبْ
   اُكْتُبْ (uktub) means write.

13. A — اِلْمَسْ أَنْفَكَ
   اِلْمَسْ أَنْفَكَ (ilmis anfaka) means touch your nose.

14. B — The weather is rainy.
   الْجَوُّ مُمْطِرٌ (al-jawwu mumtir) means: The weather is rainy.

15. D — الْجَوُّ غَائِمٌ
   الْجَوُّ غَائِمٌ (al-jawwu ghaa'im) means: The weather is cloudy.

16. C — The weather is cloudy.
   الْجَوُّ غَائِمٌ (al-jawwu ghaa'im) means: The weather is cloudy.

17. A — taa
   The letter ت is called taa.

18. C — kasra, a small line below the letter
   kasra is written below the letter and gives the vowel i.

19. A — From right to left
   Arabic is read from right to left.

20. C — My sister is beautiful.
   أُخْتِي جَمِيلَةٌ (ukhtii jamiila) means: My sister is beautiful.

21. D — Thursday
   al-khamiis is Thursday, the fifth day, from the word for five.

22. D — الْأَحَدُ
   الْأَحَدُ (al-ahad) means Sunday.

23. B — تَفَضَّلْ
   تَفَضَّلْ (tafaddal) means please, go ahead.

24. D — The voice rises at the end
   A question ends with a rising voice.

25. C — milʿaqa
   مِلْعَقَةٌ is read milʿaqa and means spoon.

26. D — A folder of the class's best work
   A portfolio keeps work together to be shown and reviewed.

27. D — We dance.
   نَحْنُ نَرْقُصُ (nahnu narqusu) means: We dance.

28. B — مِلْحٌ
   مِلْحٌ (milh) means salt.

29. A — أَرُزٌّ
   أَرُزٌّ (aruzz) means rice.

30. A — The wind is strong.
   الرِّيحُ قَوِيَّةٌ (ar-riihu qawiyya) means: The wind is strong.

SECTION B
----
31. (2 marks)
   Answer: How is the weather today?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

32. (3 marks)
   Answer: Draw local foods, write the Arabic name under each picture, colour it and post it on the wall for review.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for drawing, 1 mark for labels and 1 mark for posting or review.

33. (2 marks)
   Answer: jad-da-tun (grandmother). The syllables are read in order and joined.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the correct word and 1 mark for the meaning.

34. (2 marks)
   Answer: We look after the environment.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

35. (3 marks)
   Answer: Hide a small object. One learner asks ayna l-qalam? The other answers with a sentence such as al-qalamu taHta l-kursii. Then swap.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for hiding an object, 1 mark for the question and 1 mark for the answer sentence.

36. (2 marks)
   Answer: I am a pupil (girl).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

37. (2 marks)
   Answer: Who is this? (a boy or man)
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

38. (2 marks)
   Answer: The weather is rainy.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

39. (3 marks)
   Answer: Lifting arms for the sun; wiggling fingers downwards for rain; smiling at the last line.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each cue that matches a word.

40. (5 marks)
   Answer: For example ʿiid (festival), hafla (party), hadiyya (gift), baaluun (balloon), kaʿka (cake).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with its meaning.

41. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example maize and bananas. al-mawzu ladhiidh. The banana is delicious.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for two foods, 1 mark for a correct sentence and 1 mark for its meaning.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: Look at the speaker; do not talk while someone is speaking; think about the topic; listen for words you know; ask a question at the end.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid behaviour, up to 3.

43. (2 marks)
   Answer: Keep the key in a safe place such as the cupboard; keep knives out of reach of small children; keep lamps away from water.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each safe way.

44. (4 marks)
   Answer: Draw the item, colour it, write its Arabic name under it from right to left, write the meaning and check the spelling.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example Naskh, Ruqʿah and Kufic. Naskh is used in printed books.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each style named (up to 2) and 1 mark for a correct use.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: My mother cooks.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

47. (5 marks)
   Answer: For example shams (sun), sahaab (clouds), matar (rain), riih (wind), samaa' (sky).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with its meaning.

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: My father works.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.
